Case No.: EXT-2021-01 Location: 300 W. Foothill Boulevard, Azusa CA 91702
APN: 8616-005-001, -002
Applicant: JWDA-MS Architects
The City of Azusa received an Extension of Time request for 2-year extension for a previously approved project that included a Design Review (DR-2019-14) and Tentative Tract Map (TTM-82805). The property is located in the Route 66 District within the Azusa TOD Specific Plan.
The City already found the Project categorically exempt from CEQA under the Class 32 exemption, approved the Project, and filed a Notice of Exemption for the Project in 2019. The application for an Extension of Time would not alter the Project and would not result in any new potentially significant environmental impacts. Accordingly, because the application for an Extension of Time is part of an already approved project deemed categorically exempt from CEQA, no additional environmental review is necessary for the application under CEQA. (State CEQA Guidelines, § 15378, subd. (c).)
